name: @activepieces/piece-fathom-analytics
description: Privacy-focused website analytics. Query your site traffic, manage sites and events, and generate custom reports.

auth.description:
To create an API token:
1. Go to [https://app.usefathom.com/api](https://app.usefathom.com/api)
2. Click **Create new**
3. Give your token a name and set permissions (Admin, Read Only, or site-specific)
4. Click **Save changes**
5. Copy your API token — you won't be able to retrieve it again after navigating away

list_sites.name: list_sites
list_sites.description: Return a list of all sites this API key has access to.

limit.description: Number of sites to return (1–100). Default is 10.

starting_after.description: Cursor for forward pagination — the last site ID from the previous page.

ending_before.description: Cursor for backward pagination — the first site ID from the previous page.

aiMetadata.description: List all Fathom Analytics sites the API key can access, with optional cursor pagination (starting_after / ending_before) and a per-page limit. Use it to discover available site IDs before calling site-, event-, or aggregation-scoped actions. Read-only and safe to repeat.

get_site.name: get_site
get_site.description: Retrieve details for a specific site by its ID.

site_id.description: The unique identifier for the Fathom site (e.g., CDBUGS).

aiMetadata.description: Fetch the details of a single Fathom Analytics site by its site ID (e.g. CDBUGS). Use it when you already know the target site ID and need its metadata; call List Sites first if you only have a name. Read-only and safe to repeat.

create_event.name: create_event
create_event.description: Create a custom event (goal) for a specific site.

site_id.description: The unique identifier for the Fathom site.

aiMetadata.description: Create a new custom event (conversion goal) under a Fathom Analytics site, identified by site ID and a goal name. Use it to set up a goal before tracking conversions against it. Not idempotent — each call creates another event, so repeated calls with the same name can produce duplicates.

list_events.name: list_events
list_events.description: List all custom events (goals) for a specific site.

site_id.description: The unique identifier for the Fathom site.

limit.description: Number of events to return (1–100). Default is 10.

starting_after.description: Cursor for forward pagination — the last event ID from the previous page.

ending_before.description: Cursor for backward pagination — the first event ID from the previous page.

aiMetadata.description: List the custom events (conversion goals) defined on a Fathom Analytics site, identified by site ID, with optional cursor pagination and a per-page limit. Use it to discover event IDs and names before aggregating event metrics or creating new goals. Read-only and safe to repeat.

get_aggregation.name: get_aggregation
get_aggregation.description: Generate a custom analytics aggregation report. Supports flexible grouping, filtering, and date ranges.

entity.description: Whether to aggregate pageviews or events.

entity_id.description: The Fathom site ID to query (e.g., CDBUGS). Required when Entity Type is "Pageview".

site_id.description: The Fathom site ID that owns the event. Required when Entity Type is "Event".

entity_name.description: The ID of the specific event to aggregate. Required when Entity Type is "Event". Find event IDs via the List Events action.

aggregates.description: The metrics to include in the report.

date_grouping.description: Group results by this time unit.

field_grouping.description: Group results by this field (e.g., pathname, browser). Makes the report actionable by breaking down totals.

date_from.description: Start date for the report in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000000Z).

date_to.description: End date for the report in ISO 8601 format (e.g., 2024-12-31T23:59:59.999999Z).

timezone.description: Timezone for the report (e.g., "America/New_York", "Europe/London"). Defaults to UTC.

sort_by.description: Field and direction to sort by (e.g., "pageviews:desc" or "uniques:asc").

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

filters.description: Optional array of filter objects. Example: [{"property": "pathname", "operator": "is", "value": "/blog"}]

aiMetadata.description: Run a custom analytics aggregation report over a Fathom Analytics site, returning chosen metrics with optional date-range, date/field grouping, filters, sorting, and limit. Operates in two modes set by entity type: "pageview" aggregates page traffic (requires the site ID in entity_id), while "event" aggregates a specific conversion goal (requires both site_id and the event ID in entity_name). Use it to answer traffic or conversion questions; read-only and safe to repeat.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

To create an API token:
1. Go to [https://app.usefathom.com/api](https://app.usefathom.com/api)
2. Click **Create new**
3. Give your token a name and set permissions (Admin, Read Only, or site-specific)
4. Click **Save changes**
5. Copy your API token — you won't be able to retrieve it again after navigating away

pt.Privacy-focused website analytics. Query: Análise do site focada na privacidade. Consulte o tráfego do seu site, gerencie sites e eventos e gere relatórios personalizados.
pt.\nTo create an API token:\n1. Go to [htt:
Para criar um token de API:
1. Vá para [https://app.usefathom.com/api](https://app.usefathom.com/api)
2. Clique em **Criar novo**
3. Dê ao seu token um nome e defina permissões (Admin, Somente Leia ou especifique)
4. Clique em **Salvar alterações**
5. Copie seu token de API — você não será capaz de recuperá-lo novamente depois de navegar fora

pt.Generate a custom analytics aggregation: Gera um relatório personalizado de agregação de análises. Suporta grupos flexíveis, filtragem e intervalos de datas.
pt.Make a custom API call to a specific end: Faça uma chamada de API personalizada para um ponto de extremidade específico
